description: Saves an episode’s Ania Script: { titulo, cenas: [{ id, layout, conteudo, falas: [{ id, texto }] }] } (project fields such as apresentadores or marca may be overridden). It is validated with the renderer’s own schema first: on errors NOTHING is saved and the problems come back (in Portuguese) for you to fix and call again; warnings are returned after saving. Layout ids come from studio_listar_layouts. Write calm speech (short sentences), one idea per scene. Free.

language.description: The user's language as a BCP-47 tag (e.g. 'en', 'en-US', 'pt-BR', 'es'). Replies and prices follow it.

revisao.description: Revision you read (studio_ver_episodio); refused if it changed since.

roteiro.description: The episode script (Ania Script v1 without schema/projeto).
